notes.title: Tales of the Lumminai v1.5.3
notes.content:
Updated game to match RPG Maker MV 1.6 version
Fixed an error preventing "Burst" skills from replacing the guard command when at 100 TP, changed to 99 so it works.
Fixed an error preventing Legendary skills from replacing the guard command when at 100 TP, changed to 99 so it works.

Fixed a problem where you would lose 500 Zell when talking to certain NPC's in Port Au Venfey, this should no longer occur
Fixed an error where the game would crash if you used the skill "Blood Devourer", was caused by a missing summon image
Fixed the summon command from not appearing once it has been learned at level 35 on various characters
Fixed a problem with the Tower of Trials sending you back outside if you use a healing skill while inbetween floors

Changed the Castle Greymoore maps to better fit Wynn's theme. These were very generic before since they were made quite early.
Added a secondary route to enter the Forgotten Crypts maps in the desert region
Added an option to opt out of doing criminal quests and choose to fight the bandits near Bastion instead if you prefer

notes.title: Tales of the Lumminai v1.5.1
notes.content:
Overhauled the Legendary Creatures hunting to forcefully spawn them in designated areas since random wasn't working

Fixed the sprites for the Legendary Creatures to properly show the size and gold diamond they are supposed to

Fixed a transition arrow from vanishing after entering the Weshrain general shop

Fixed an error with various NPC pathing, which caused them to appear on Weshrain buildings roofs

Fixed the description of various items/skills to properly reflect their effects

Changed the Legendary Creatures spawn trigger to be 25 kills of a special species of enemy that will start appearing after level 15

Changed the Legendary spawn to trigger once 25 enemies are killed and the party is level 15 or higher upon entering the designated areas

Moved the Legendary Centaurii to Basilisk Tooth Passage, can be spawned after level 15 and defeating 25 Centaurii Spirits

Moved the Spider Queen to a designated location in the Aurora Peaks Cavern 3F, can be spawned after level 15 and defeating 25 Spider Offsprings

Moved the Legendary Carbunk to the Eastern Prairie map outside of Kawajack Ranch, can be spawned after level 15 and defeating 25 Carbunk Spirits

Moved the Legendary Kirin to the NW Wisparya Forest, can be spawned after level 15 and defeating 25 Kirin Spirits

Added the special enemies in each of the regions Legendary creatures will spawn at, they will appear after level 15 party level

Added a failsafe trigger to set the kill counts of each special creature to Weshrain, please go there before fighting any of them to ensure it will work properly!

notes.title: Tales of the Lumminai v1.5
notes.content:
Fixed a problem with the transition arrow for the Basilisk Tooth Passage, should be able to go there after Chapter 3 now

Fixed an error with the Guild Task "Fur For Days!", which was causing it to not track progress

Fixed positioning of Hunter Joel, pushing him off the cliff back to the ground. His side quest can now be accepted again since he is interactable again.

Fixed grammar errors on one of the Castle briefings

Fixed an error with the skills that caused stunning or stagger status, these will no longer freeze the game when enemies are stunned.

Fixed an error where enemies weren't spawning on the Aurora Peak Base map

Fixed an error after swapping party members in battle, previously caused crashing due to missing data

Fixed an error with map display in Wisparya Forest segments

Fixed an error that prevented Indie from spawning for the third time

Fixed an error with a tree blocking access to a treasure chest in the Deda Woodlands

Fixed an error with the skill "Temptation", which was causing it to freeze the game before

Fixed an error with the skill "Blade Tsunami", which would end the battle by inflicting KO status on all enemies for some reason.

Fixed an error that prevented the Syrencii on the shore from appearing

Fixed an error with the side quest "Syrencii on the Shore" that was previously locking the player in the spot where the Syrencii should've been

Fixed an error with the flashsequence in the Aquducts that was causing frame drops after seeing it

Fixed an error where the player could walk on the walls in Weshrain

Fixed an error that prevented Indie from spawning in Weshrain. It was previously spawning a little girl NPC instead for whatever reason.

Added a Turbo Speed system to the game. Simply hold down the action button while in combat to initiate it and speed the battle up. This should resolve any further lag issues during the battle animations. I don't recommend using this feature in boss battles since it may cause problems with dialogue and other eventing that takes place in there. Use in boss battles at your own risk!

Added an alternate map transition to the Basilisk Tooth Passage

Added a forced spawn location for Indie in Anderas Village. He will now spawn on the road there if you've met him before in Venfey.

Changed the appearance of Legendary enemies to be more easily recognizeable

Changed the spawn ratio for Legendaries so they spawn more frequently

Changed various stats on enemies for better balancing

Changed the damage calculation on some skills for better balancing

Changed the effect of "Burning Temple" from a chance of inflicting burning to a guaranteed infliction rate

Changed the harshness of Decay status to be less lethal in common battles after having it inflicted on the party

Changed the description of some signs to better describe location names. These were meant to be changed before since I had decided on different names for those regions after, but somehow overlooked them, but they're all fixed now!

 Changed the overall difficulty of the Tower of Trials to be better scaled based on progression. Lower floors will be easier now while the higher ones will become more and more difficult as you go. This will help with levelling up while inside the tower and training allies!

notes.title: Tales of the Lumminai v1.2
notes.content:
- Fixed Lumi's dialogue to mention the "R Key" as the proper Relationship keybind instead of Zero. It will require you to have the Book of Relations, but earlier players may not have this and will get it later in the story.

- Added a failsafe, Book of Relations, to the village of Anderas for those who didn't get it before during the introduction for Relations.

- Removed duplicated Guild Tasks and a looping problem when choosing the "Nevermind" option. The choices both work properly now without any further looping or duplication of the list.

- Changed the first Qutemaia fight to insta-end after 3 turns of trying to fight her. You are intended to lose this one. Dialogue goes with it as well now as it should have before, but wasn't triggering properly.

- Fixed the order of Chapter 2's events in Weshrain upon arrival and when going into the inn. They now play in the order they were meant to, instead of backward like before.

- Adjusted dash options to allow dashing on the Kawajack Ranch and the Eastern Prairie. Originally these were disabled there because certain events required slower movement, but this is no longer the case and you should now be able to dash there freely.

- Fixed Guild Tasks not giving the drops (variable change) upon defeating the indicated enemies. They now work as the task expects, and you should be able to get the full rewards for completing them now.

- Fixed a bug with the time system allowing the hour to pass 24 when entering Guild Task Zones. This should have automatically fixed itself before, but it didn't. The time will now reset to hour zero on the next day if the hour passes 24.

- Fixed Catherine's skills requiring an unknown weapon type. Removed the requirement as she can change her weapon with a skill to conjure a sword, so having any weapon requirement on these weapons would just interrupt the skills. They no longer require any weapon types to use, so they should work as intended.

- During the scenes in the cell, Lucia's direction was locked. I've fixed this so the events should play out accordingly and afterward you'll be able to move and change directions again as you should be able to. 

- Added indicators to the interactable objects in the cell to make it easier to understand what you need to do there. Each object adds 1 to a variable. Once the variable hits 4 something will happen that progresses the story further. This should all work the way it's supposed to now. (Objects on the ground you will have to walk on to trigger)

- Adjusted move routes to enemies in the Depths to make avoiding them slightly easier.

- Added further adjustments to enemy stats as well as playable character stats.

- Added Lumberjack and Treasure Hunter to Port Au Venfey for the adventurous and crafty players to interact with. 

- Fixed a problem with the Legendary (elite) enemies that prevented them from ever appearing. They should now show up, but the rate is 1 in 50, so they will be extremely rare. After collecting the trophies of 5 of them, you will unlock the Swamps Guild Task Zone which has great rewards for completing the involved tasks.

notes.title: Tales of the Lumminai v1.1.5
notes.content:
Reworked the events that trigger the Chapter 2 auto start. For anyone experiencing looping, please restart the game and this should fix any further looping caused by that. You will now be prompted to enter the inn manually, rather than being teleported directly there so you can enter at any time you feel like it.

Changed title screen BGM to better fit the theme of the game.

Fixed a fading issue where the game would remain in a black screen if you opted to leave Weshrain immediately for Chapter 2's events. It should now fade back in properly as intended.

Fixed a small problem with Lumi not appearing and pathing correctly during the Chapter 2 starting scene. She should approach you as intended now without any pathing errors.

Adjustments to how the inn gab chatter works, so it will no longer be visible during the black screen where Lumi is telling you about what she did while you slept in the inn. It was causing an overlap so needed to be changed to read the scenes dialogue properly.

Added a bit of dialogue to explain the time jump at the start of the game. This should help a bit with clearing up confusion caused by that. The actual events are explained later in greater detail.

Adjustments to Laguis' skills during her boss fight so that she's not doing only 7 damage to the party. She is meant to do around 20-25 damage each hit giving a reason for all those Hopa Vials you were given before. This should now work the way we wanted it to.

Adjustments to the "First Aid" skill so that it's based off of current health rather than maximum health. This will help during the Dimach third fight which seemed more difficult because of the 3k healing. He should heal only 15% of his current health now, making it far less when he has lower health.

Fixed a small problem with a side quest causing the rewards to not be given to the player. You should now get every reward that was mentioned for completing the side quest.

Fixed an error in costume changing, which was causing the portrait to appear outside of the menus and battle. You should no longer see the costume portrait on the game window unless you have the inventory menu opened.
